primary_claim.text: At 1/4-frame retention on traverse sequences, POSITION + EMBEDDING_CHANGE uses ≤ 35 % of SEND_ALL bytes, keeps ≥ 90 % of archived traverse frames within 5 m of a kept full-quality frame, keeps ≥ 0.90 visual-change coverage, leaves no archived traverse frame farther than 10 m from a kept frame in any sequence, and breaks 0 stereo pairs.
primary_claim.C3_visual: visual-change coverage (mean best cosine similarity to a kept frame) ≥ 0.90
primary_claim.C4_max_distance_to_kept: max over sequences of MAX_DISTANCE_TO_KEPT_M ≤ 10.0 m
primary_claim.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 3 traverse sequences (≥ 10 frames) OR fewer than 90 % of traverse frames with a PLACES position

marginal_embedding_value.SPATIAL_COST: 5 m coverage(POSITION+EMBEDDING) − 5 m coverage(POSITION), at 1/4 (negative = cost)
marginal_embedding_value.GAP_DIFFERENCES: differences in MAX_DISTANCE_TO_KEPT_M, p95 gap, max gap (reported)
marginal_embedding_value.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over traverse sequences, 10,000 resamples, seed 20260926, 95 % percentile interval
marginal_embedding_value.MATERIAL_SPATIAL_COST: SPATIAL_COST < −0.020 OR POSITION+EMBEDDING fails C4 while POSITION passes
marginal_embedding_value.EQUIVALENT_NO_REGRESSION: |VISUAL_CHANGE_GAIN| < 0.020 AND SPATIAL_COST ≥ −0.020 AND POSITION+EMBEDDING meets C4
marginal_embedding_value.why_0.020: twice the development spread between the two simple baselines at 1/4 (UNIFORM 0.922 vs EVERY_NTH 0.931, Δ 0.009); about half the development gain (+0.044)

PROCEED_TO_FINAL_TEST_950_979_ONLY_IF: Scheduler V3: 0 monotonicity decreases (acquisitions, scene clusters, rover positions, stereo present, stereo usable; primary orders × 80 budgets) and 0 single-eye usable stereo pairs
0 broken stereo pairs in every traverse selection
decision_rule_before_final_test.otherwise: STOP; do not consume the final test; report that the Phase 3 result did not generalize robustly enough
decision_rule_before_final_test.even_if_passed: STOP and wait for explicit approval before downloading 950–979
